decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet sits close to the firm's core prescription offer and has its own product page, so early results are unlikely to fall far below aspiration, and slack lets the firm carry it while uptake builds.

The generic antidepressant is distant from the core offer and faces price-driven competition under reimbursement contracts, which raises the risk of a shortfall against aspiration, but after one year evidence is too thin to trigger a drop.
The combination antihypertensive line fits the firm's cardiovascular competence, offers several models and supports adherence, so it likely meets aspirations and justifies keeping it.

The bone and joint supplement only gets a website mention, which suggests low emphasis and a crowded market, but it matches the strategy of pharmacy-exclusive self-care products and is cheap to carry.
